wiki.title: Eric Emery
wiki.extract: Eric E. Emery is an American Democratic politician and emergency medical services (EMS) professional who is a member of the South Dakota House of Representatives for District 26A. He is the program director of the Rosebud Sioux Tribe Ambulance Service in Rosebud, South Dakota. From 2015 to 2021, he was on the National Emergency Medical Services Advisory Council (NEMSAC), providing policy guidance to the United States Department of Transportation. In the South Dakota Legislature, Emery has concentrated on rural health initiatives, EMS system sustainability, tribal public health policy, and legislation to establish EMS as an essential service in the state.
